metrics.evidence: the CMDC uses informed judgement to determine OC members' pay based on four broad performance dimensions
Risk, Controls & Conduct, including feedback received from the Firm's risk and control professionals
Client/Customer/Stakeholder, including our engagement in communities and commitment to provide economic opportunity to underserved communities
Teamwork & Leadership, including creating a diverse, inclusive, respectful and accountable environment, and developing employees, managers and leaders

metrics.metric: Diversity, equity and inclusion priorities progress
metrics.evidence: Diversity, equity and inclusion priorities and progress are incorporated into year-end performance evaluations and compensation decisions for OC members
the ultimate number of PSUs paid out at vesting is determined by a pre-established formula based on the Firm's absolute and relative ROTCE performance over the subsequent three years

metrics.metric: CET1 capital ratio minimum risk-based hurdle
metrics.evidence: If the Firm's common equity Tier 1 ("CET1") capital ratio is less than 7.5% at any year-end, then up to one-third of unvested PSUs will be subject to downward adjustment
